text:
Maya S: Hey team — noticed ~3 eval runs from last night missing sample_seed and client_metadata in trace files. Uploads reported success but the JSON blobs have empty fields. Seen on runs: 2026-03-17T23:40Z, 2026-03-18T00:05Z. Link to docs: https://redwood.intern/docs/eval/traces
Samir K: Hmm, did we change the retry path in runner v0.8.2? There's a codepath that reconstructs a trace manifest on upload retry and I think it skips run_context on partial batches. cc @Alex P
Alex P: Logs show a 413 then retry with smaller payload. Snippet from runner logs:
```
[2026-03-18T00:05:12Z] upload_trace: 413 PayloadTooLarge -> retrying without gzip
[2026-03-18T00:05:13Z] upload_trace: success (manifest created, payload_size=1.1MB)
// BUT manifest fields: client_metadata: null, sample_seed: null
```
Toni L: CI schema validator (tests/eval/trace_schema_test.py) started failing on main because of strict_keys=True. We can relax to optional for schema <= 1.1, but we should also make sure new traces always include run_context.
Samir K: Proposed quick fix: ensure Trace.serialize() always populates run_context and sample_seed even for partial/retry uploads. I'll open a small PR to eng-ml. Also we should bump trace schema minor version to v1.2 and add fallback parsing for missing fields.
Maya S: Also: storage TTL noticed — some of these traces are under prefix /eval-traces/auto/ and lifecycle was 90d. Product wants 180d for eval artifacts. Who owns s3 lifecycle rules?
Alex P: Infra ticket exists but per-prefix lifecycle isn't applied consistently. We can tag uploads with x-trace-ttl or a tag like eval:long-retain and have lifecycle rules pick it up. PR idea: add optional header from uploader config -> uploader adds s3-tagging.
Samir K: Quick patch for serializer ready locally, unit tests pass. For backfill: we should run a validation job that scans traces for missing run_context and re-ingests enriched manifests (where we can reconstruct) — I'll draft a backfill plan.
upload-bot: upload-bot: ERROR: trace-upload failed for run id r-2026-03-17-abc123 -> Retrying (2/3)
Toni L: I'll relax the CI check to avoid blocking deploys: change strict_keys -> warn for schema <=1.1 and add an integration test in CI that runs scripts/validate_trace_schema.py over recent S3 prefixes. Also add a small shim in eval-harness to ensure sample ids are never empty before serialization.
Maya S: Action items summary: 1) @Samir K push serializer PR and backfill plan; 2) @Toni L update CI validator + add scripts/validate_trace_schema.py; 3) @Alex P add TTL/tag header in uploader and coordinate with infra for lifecycle rule; 4) I'll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow 11:00am PT to confirm backfill window and cutover. Thanks 👍 :thumbsup:
